name: clicksign
description: Send documents for e-signature and track signing status in Clicksign.

interface.longDescription: Clicksign is the official connector for your Clicksign account. Send documents for electronic signature from your templates or from a file link, check who has already signed and who is still pending, and send reminders to pending signers, all from a conversation. Sending an envelope or a reminder notifies the signers by email (or WhatsApp/SMS when configured) and cannot be undone, so ChatGPT asks for your confirmation first. Requires an existing Clicksign account; the connector only accesses the account you authorize and does not sign documents on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Who still needs to sign my latest envelope?
Send a reminder to pending signers.

positive.description: List the templates available in the connected Clicksign account.
positive.prompt: Quais modelos de documento eu tenho na Clicksign?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's templates (including 'NDA Padrão') with their names; no write action is performed.

positive.description: Report who has signed and who is still pending on an existing envelope.
positive.prompt: Quem ainda não assinou o envelope 'Contrato ACME'?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the envelope by name and lists each signer with status signed or pending plus a summary (1 signed, 1 pending).

positive.description: Send a template-based envelope for e-signature after user confirmation.
positive.prompt: Envie o modelo 'NDA Padrão' para Maria Teste (qa+maria@<domínio>) assinar por e-mail, com nome = Maria Teste.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation before sending, then creates and starts the envelope and returns its id; the signer receives the signature request email.

positive.description: Send a PDF from a public HTTPS link for e-signature.
positive.prompt: Mande este PDF https://<url-de-teste>/contrato.pdf para João Teste (qa+joao@<domínio>) assinar por e-mail.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, creates the envelope using the file from the URL (filename derived from the URL) and returns the envelope id.

positive.description: Remind pending signers of a running envelope.
positive.prompt: Reenvie o lembrete para quem está pendente no envelope 'Contrato ACME'.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, sends the reminder by email to the pending signer and reports who was notified; a second request within one minute is reported as rate-limited.

negative.description: Signing on behalf of a signer is not supported and must be refused.
negative.prompt: Assine o 'Contrato ACME' por mim no lugar do signatário pendente.
Faça um Pix de R$ 500 para o fornecedor do Contrato ACME.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not supported by the plugin.
negative.prompt: Apague todos os meus envelopes da Clicksign.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: send envelopes from templates or file links, track signer status, send reminders and manage templates.

pt-BR.subtitle: Envie e acompanhe assinaturas
pt-BR.description: Conector oficial da sua conta Clicksign. Envie documentos para assinatura eletrônica a partir de modelos ou de um link de arquivo, veja quem já assinou e quem está pendente e envie lembretes, tudo pela conversa. Enviar um envelope ou lembrete notifica os signatários por e-mail (ou WhatsApp/SMS, quando configurado) e não pode ser desfeito, por isso o ChatGPT pede sua confirmação antes. Requer uma conta Clicksign existente; o conector acessa somente a conta autorizada e não assina documentos em seu nome.
